----1st
select b.rn,a.* 
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance a
INNER JOIN
(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE ORDER BY PeriodEndDate DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC) RN
,CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance) b 
ON a.CustomerAccountId=b.CustomerAccountId
AND a.PeriodBalanceTypeId=b.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND a.PeriodStartDate=b.PeriodStartDate
AND a.FinancialInstitutionId=b.FinancialInstitutionId
AND a.SOURCESYSTEMCODE=b.SOURCESYSTEMCODE
WHERE b.rn>1

----2nd
DELETE a
FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance a
INNER JOIN
(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE ORDER BY PeriodEndDate DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC) RN
,CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId,PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCESYSTEMCODE FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance) b 
ON a.CustomerAccountId=b.CustomerAccountId
AND a.PeriodBalanceTypeId=b.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND a.PeriodStartDate=b.PeriodStartDate
AND a.FinancialInstitutionId=b.FinancialInstitutionId
AND a.SOURCESYSTEMCODE=b.SOURCESYSTEMCODE
WHERE b.rn>1
